title: Nutritional Programs: ICDS, POSHAN Abhiyaan and Growth Monitoring

steps.title: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)
steps.tx: Launched in 1975, the centrally sponsored **Integrated Child Development Services scheme** represents one of the largest early childhood care and development networks in the world. Administered by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, ICDS delivers an integrated package of six core services targeting children under six years of age, pregnant women, and lactating mothers to break vicious intergenerational cycles of malnutrition, infection and developmental delay.
steps.say: Launched in 1975, the Integrated Child Development Services scheme provides food, preschool learning and healthcare to mothers and children under six across every village.

steps.title: The Anganwadi Centre: focal village institution
steps.tx: The focal grassroots delivery point in rural and tribal villages is the **Anganwadi Centre institution**, established on a population norm of one centre per eight hundred population in rural and urban areas (and one per three hundred in difficult tribal or hilly terrain). Staffed by an honorary resident female Anganwadi Worker and an Anganwadi Helper, the centre serves as a crèche, supplementary feeding station, preschool classroom and community immunization point.
steps.say: The village Anganwadi Centre serves as a neighbourhood preschool, health clinic and food distribution hub, operated by a resident female worker and her helper.

steps.tx: A hanging scale in a village room is growth monitoring inside the local Anganwadi, not a hospital clinic. The **Anganwadi Centre institution** is planned as one centre for every 800 people in rural and urban areas, and one for every 300 people in difficult tribal or hilly ground. An honorary local woman worker and a helper staff it. The same room serves as a creche, a supplementary feeding point, a preschool, and the site of community immunisation.
steps.say: One Anganwadi is set up for about 800 people, or for about 300 in difficult tribal or hill areas. A local woman worker and a helper run preschool, supplementary feeding, weighing, and immunisation from that room.

steps.title: Supplementary nutrition norms and take-home rations
steps.tx: Under statutory provisions of the National Food Security Act, the programme mandates **supplementary nutrition provision** for three hundred days annually. Normal preschool children receive five hundred kilocalories and twelve to fifteen grams of protein daily; severely malnourished children receive eight hundred kilocalories and twenty to twenty-five grams of protein as therapeutic rations; pregnant and nursing mothers receive six hundred kilocalories and eighteen to twenty grams of protein.
steps.say: Anganwadis provide meals for three hundred days a year. Normal children receive five hundred calories, while severely malnourished children receive eight hundred calories daily.

rows: Hot cooked meal (3-6 yrs) / THR (6-36 mos)

steps.title: POSHAN Abhiyaan: National Nutrition Mission
steps.tx: To galvanize multi-sectoral convergence, the government launched **POSHAN Abhiyaan initiatives**, an overarching national nutrition mission designed to reduce stunting, undernutrition and low birth weight by two percent annually, and anaemia among children and women by three percent annually. Built on technology and behavioural nudges, it equips Anganwadi workers with smartphones running the Poshan Tracker app, enforces real-time digital monitoring, and mobilizes monthly Poshan Maah campaigns.
steps.say: POSHAN Abhiyaan is India's national mission to cut stunting and anaemia. Frontline workers use smartphones with the Poshan Tracker app to monitor child feeding in real time.

steps.title: PM POSHAN: school mid-day meal scheme
steps.tx: The nationwide school nutrition scheme **PM POSHAN mid-day meal** provides hot cooked lunches to all children attending government and government-aided primary and upper primary schools for at least two hundred days each year. Primary children receive four hundred and fifty kilocalories and twelve grams of protein daily, while upper primary children receive seven hundred kilocalories and twenty grams of protein, simultaneously improving school attendance and childhood nutritional status.
steps.say: PM POSHAN serves hot lunches in government schools. Primary students receive four hundred and fifty calories, while older students get seven hundred calories, boosting both health and learning.

steps.title: WHO child growth standards and growth monitoring
steps.tx: Routine growth surveillance uses the **WHO child growth standards**, which depict the biological growth potential of healthy breastfed infants raised in optimal socioeconomic and hygienic environments worldwide. Frontline workers plot monthly body weight against age on standardized gender-specific growth charts, comparing trajectories against median, minus two, and minus three standard deviation Z-score lines to identify subtle growth faltering before clinical wasting appears.
steps.say: Monthly growth charts plot a child's weight against age. A flattening curve gives an early warning of growth faltering weeks before visible wasting or illness develops.

steps.title: Nutritional anthropometry: Salter scale and infantometer
steps.tx: Accurate field growth monitoring relies on **nutritional anthropometry instrumentation**, using calibrated digital or spring-loaded Salter hanging scales to weigh infants to the nearest one hundred grams. Recumbent crown-to-heel length is measured using a rigid wooden infantometer for children under two years of age (or standing height below eighty-five centimetres), while a vertical stadiometer measures standing height in children aged two years and older.
steps.say: Weigh infants on hanging Salter scales to the nearest hundred grams. Measure babies lying down on an infantometer, and measure children older than two years standing up on a stadiometer.

steps.title: Diet survey methodology: weighment method
steps.tx: To quantify community dietary consumption, nutritional researchers execute a standardized **diet survey weighment method**, considered the most accurate field technique for rural households. A trained field investigator visits the home before meal preparation and uses a calibrated scale to weigh raw food ingredients (raw weighment method) or measures cooked portions served and leftover plates (cooked weighment method) continuously over seven consecutive days.
steps.say: The weighment method visits homes before cooking to weigh all raw grains, vegetables and cooking oil. Recording food weights over a full week reveals exact family nutrient intakes.

steps.title: Nutritional surveillance and early warning systems
steps.tx: At the district and state levels, health administrators maintain continuous **nutritional surveillance systems** to track chronic trends and detect impending famine emergencies before mortality surges. Routine indicators combine monthly Anganwadi growth charts, seasonal rainfall deficits, market grain prices, distress migration patterns, and agricultural wage trends, triggering emergency buffer food grain releases and intensified child supplementary feeding.
steps.say: Nutritional surveillance monitors child weights, rainfall, grain prices and rural distress migration. Tracking these trends provides an early warning to rush extra food before famine strikes.
